name: corrector
description: A Socratic, personalised DSA coach that lives beside your coding session.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @corrector/extension && npm run build -w @corrector/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @corrector/core && npm run typecheck -w @corrector/overlay && npm run typecheck -w @corrector/extension && npm run typecheck -w @corrector/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
